description: American folk royalty Jessica Pratt joins us for a four show residency to celebrate the arrival of her first album in 5 years, Here in the Pitch out May 3rd. Expect choices from her expansive pool of influences, including spectral ’60s indie, Hollywood shock rock and psychedelia.
